top_messages.text: Suspect: Dear Richard, Thank you for your prompt acceptance of our grant offer and for your enthusiasm in collaborating with The Institute of Advanced Research. We are equally excited about the opportunity to work with you and contribute to your research in solar-powered water desalination systems. To finalize the grant agreement, please review and sign the attached document. This document outlines the grant terms and conditions, including the grant amount, disbursement schedule, and reporting requirements. Once signed, please return the document to me for our records.
